# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release. Please update to it before you report a problem.

## Reporting a problem

**Please don't report security problems in a public issue, on Discord or in a pull request.**

Report them privately on GitHub instead: open the [Security tab](https://github.com/ZhFahim/anchor/security) and choose **Report a vulnerability**.

Please include:

- what the problem is and what an attacker could do with it,
- the steps to reproduce it,
- the versions of the app and the server,
- your setup, if it matters (for example a reverse proxy or an OIDC provider).

You will get a reply as soon as possible. Once the problem is fixed and released, the report can be made public, with credit to you if you want it.
